meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 当你需要某项能力时,Claude 会先查看技能排行榜,再用命令行搜索可安装的技能包,向你推荐名称、安装量和安装命令,并能直接帮你安装。
howto.when: 当用户询问如何完成某任务、寻找现成技能、或表示想扩展能力时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个能生成 changelog 的技能
say.note: Claude 会搜索并推荐相关技能。

say.text: 有没有 React 性能优化的技能?
say.note: 会按关键词搜索并给出安装命令。

say.text: 你能帮我做 PR 审查吗,找找有没有相关技能
say.note: 会查找 PR 审查类技能并推荐。

howto.what_en: When the user needs a capability, Claude checks the skills leaderboard, runs a CLI search for installable skills, recommends top options with install counts and commands, and can install them on request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks how to do something, looks for an existing skill, or expresses interest in extending capabilities.

say_en.text: Find me a skill that can generate a changelog.
say_en.note: Claude will search and recommend relevant skills.

say_en.text: Is there a skill for React performance optimization?
say_en.note: It will search by keyword and provide install commands.

say_en.text: Can you help with PR reviews? Find a skill for that.
say_en.note: It will look for PR review skills and recommend them.
